'''Selia Antares''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], her droid, [[C6-N8]], tasked a traveling Republic allied hero to recover codes from [[House Ulgo]] forces in order to defuse a bomb the house had planted on a transport ship. The hero succeeded, and gave the codes to Antares.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Selia appears in the mission "Bomb on Board" for Republic classes in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the mission endpoint.<ref name="TOR" />
